metadata.title: PlatformKit — Production platform for AI-native SaaS in Go
metadata.description: PlatformKit helps AI builders turn agent demos into real products: tenants, permissions, billing, audit, admin, MCP tools, traces, evals, and governed workflows inside one modular Go platform.
metadata.keywords: platformkit, ai native saas, agentic saas, go saas framework, mcp server, ai agent runtime, modular platform, governed ai workflows

home.badge: For AI builders with real users
home.textTitle: Ship agentic products on a platform you can trust.
home.subtitle: AI builders move fast until the demo needs tenants, permissions, billing, audit, admin, evals, tool access, and human review. PlatformKit gives Go teams that production layer as modules: inspectable, replaceable, MCP-ready, and designed for agents to act inside clear contracts.

ui.experienceSectionsTitle: The production layer AI builders usually discover too late.
ui.testimonialsSubtitle: The same contracts across products that need real workflows, tenants, and evidence.
ui.builderStatus: Describe the product that keeps returning.

sections.title: The demo is not the product.
sections.subtitle: A working agent still needs users, organizations, roles, billing, audit, background jobs, admin rescue paths, content, notifications, and a place to put policy. PlatformKit gives you that layer before the rewrite starts.

sections.title: Build once. Surface everywhere.
sections.subtitle: The same module graph can power a public app, internal admin, docs portal, background workflow, MCP server, and governed agent surface. You stop rebuilding the same capability for each interface.

sections.title: Tools are product contracts.
sections.subtitle: Expose capability through typed ports, events, manifests, and MCP tools instead of fragile glue. Agents can inspect and act, while the product still owns permission, validation, and audit.

sections.title: Let agents act, but leave evidence.
sections.subtitle: The MCP server and governed runtime use the same graph the product runs on, with tool boundaries, policy gates, budgets, traces, eval hooks, human review, and audit trails.

sections.title: Taste belongs at the edge.
sections.subtitle: A product site, vertical pack, brand layer, or admin experience belongs in its client overlay or the shared design system when it becomes reusable. The platform core stays clean.

sections.title: Replace parts without losing the system.
sections.subtitle: Models will change. Agent frameworks will change. Your platform contract should survive it. PlatformKit keeps modules, migrations, events, design-system governance, and operational proof in one inspectable graph.

commodities.title: One graph, many AI surfaces
commodities.subtitle: Serve the same composition as an app, admin console, MCP server, docs portal, worker runtime, module catalog, or vertical client surface.

pricing.title: Start open. Add the production layer when the agent has users.
pricing.subtitle: Use the source to understand the contract. Buy the acceleration when you need templates, private modules, infrastructure blueprints, design-system depth, and implementation support.
